src/browser-relay-policy.ts.name: Relay rules
src/browser-relay-policy.ts.description: Keeps the host's relay tiers, decides whether a napplet-supplied relay URL is allowed, and checks that local storage really works.

src/browser-relay-runtime.ts.name: Live relay connection
src/browser-relay-runtime.ts.description: Opens live relay reads and publishes, bootstraps from NIP-65 relay lists and contacts, and reports each read to the message log.

src/browser-relay-transport.ts.name: Relay query helpers
src/browser-relay-transport.ts.description: Collects matching events from several relays until all finish, time out or hit a cap, and streams live matches without duplicates.

src/browser-social-cache.ts.name: Profile and contact memory
src/browser-social-cache.ts.description: Keeps an in-memory copy of the signed-in account's profiles and contacts, cleared when the account changes.

src/browser-worker-relay.ts.name: In-page relay
src/browser-worker-relay.ts.description: Serves events from a list kept in the page, as a relay that never leaves the browser.
